nodes.name: Simpro Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives every Simpro webhook event (Site, Company customer, Contact, Quote, Job). ⚠ No auth — see Open Issues sticky.

nodes.name: Route by Simpro Event
nodes.notes: Routes on body.name. Events with any other name are dropped silently (no fallback output).

nodes.name: Get Simpro Site
nodes.notes: Fetches the full Site from Simpro (incl. Customers[] and PrimaryContact) — the webhook only carries the ID.

nodes.name: Get Site-Contact Associations
nodes.notes: Lists contacts currently linked to this HubSpot Site.

nodes.name: Archive Site-Contact Associations
nodes.notes: Removes all existing Site→Contact links so Simpro becomes the source of truth.

nodes.name: Build Archive Site-Contact Payload
nodes.notes: Builds the batch/archive body for every existing Site→Contact link.

nodes.name: Upsert Site in HubSpot
nodes.notes: Sub-workflow: creates/updates the HubSpot Site (0-420) keyed on simpro_site_id. Returns the HubSpot record (id).

nodes.name: Upsert Site Primary Contact
nodes.notes: Sub-workflow: upserts the Site's PrimaryContact from Simpro. Fails if the site has no primary contact.

nodes.name: Associate Site with Contact
nodes.notes: Re-links the Site to its primary contact. Deliberate dead end — branch finishes here.

nodes.name: Get Site-Company Associations
nodes.notes: Lists companies currently linked to this HubSpot Site.

nodes.name: Archive Site-Company Associations
nodes.notes: Removes all existing Site→Company links before re-linking from Simpro.

nodes.name: Build Archive Site-Company Payload
nodes.notes: Builds the batch/archive body for every existing Site→Company link.

nodes.name: Upsert Site Customer
nodes.notes: Sub-workflow: upserts this customer as a HubSpot Company.

nodes.name: Associate Site with Company
nodes.notes: Links Site → Company, then returns to the loop for the next customer.

nodes.name: Split Out Site Customers
nodes.notes: FAN-OUT: one item per Simpro customer on this site.

nodes.name: Wait for Site-Company Archive
nodes.notes: Holds the customer list until the archive has finished, then passes input 2 (the customers) on.

nodes.name: Loop Over Site Customers
nodes.notes: Processes site customers one at a time (batch 1).

parameters.content:
## 🏗 Site event
Upsert Site → reset + relink Primary Contact, and reset + relink every Customer (fan-out at **Split Out Site Customers**, looped one at a time).

## 🏢 Company customer event
Upsert Company → reset + relink every Contact and every Site (two fan-outs, each looped).

## 👤 Contact event
Upsert Contact → reset + relink every Customer (Company) and every Site (two fan-outs, each looped).

## 📄 Quote event
Upsert Quote Deal → reset + relink the Deal to its Site, Contact and Company (three parallel branches, no loops).

## 🔧 Job event
Upsert Job Deal → reset + relink the Deal to its Site, Contact and Company (three parallel branches, no loops).

nodes.name: Receive Record
nodes.notes: Called once per changed record by [SPL] Simpro -> HubSpot Poller. Input data mode must read 'Accept all data'. Item shape matches the old webhook: { body: { name, reference } }.
